scope: Conservative ledger envelope and throughput-based recovery planning, not a provider bill or authorization to launch. Logged frames are upper bounds on the counters of an earlier saved resume checkpoint; no checkpoint contents were loaded.
checkpoint_evidence: Per-job read-only checkpoint_listing.txt files; resume.pt exists for every newly failed run. Root owns collection and checkpoint authentication.

budget.interpretation: The $599.8145 single-resume estimate excludes a separate diagnostic and the three additional failed models. The current $1.25/hour guard does not cover the full fixed cohort with all four continuations at the planning throughput. New recovery caps need a revised full-cohort cost calculation after diagnostics and authenticated saved counters.
